title: Krasner membership over a complete nonarchimedean normed field
statement:
Let $K$ be a complete nontrivially normed nonarchimedean field, and let $L/K$ be an algebraic field extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-algebraic-element] equipped with a norm extending that of $K$. A normed field here means a field with a real-valued norm satisfying $\|z\|\geq0$, $\|z\|=0\Leftrightarrow z=0$, $\|1\|=1$, $\|zw\|=\|z\|\|w\|$ and $\|z+w\|\leq\|z\|+\|w\|$, with distance $d(z,w)=\|z-w\|$. Completeness means every Cauchy sequence converges, nontriviality means some nonzero $z\in K$ has $\|z\|\ne1$, and nonarchimedean means $\|u+v\|\leq\max\{\|u\|,\|v\|\}$. Let $x,b\in L$, and let $f\in K[T]$ be the minimal polynomial of $x$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Suppose $f$ is separable [def-pc-separable-polynomial] and splits in $L[T]$ (a product of linear factors). If
$$\|x-b\|<\|x-y\|\quad\text{for every }y\in L\text{ with }f(y)=0\text{ and }y\ne x,$$
then $x\in K(b)$, the smallest subfield of $L$ containing $K$ and $b$.
